title: Commit: docs(catalog): ATCLang completeness pass — extend COMP-LANG to 10 functions
content:
docs(catalog): ATCLang completeness pass — extend COMP-LANG to 10 functions

Full source enumeration of the atclang repository at census HEAD
21c595dc showed the 2-function COMP-LANG entry covered only the
frontend. Added 8 source-bound functions covering the complete
compiler pipeline:

- FN-LANG-003 AST-to-bytecode lowering (lower.rs, fail-closed subset)
- FN-LANG-004 canonical bytecode encoding + worklist-fixpoint
  verification (bytecode.rs)
- FN-LANG-005 ATCA artifact envelope with SHA-256 binding (artifact.rs)
- FN-LANG-006 ABI/protocol type boundary (value.rs + ir.rs)
- FN-LANG-007 deterministic reference execution, reference-only (vm.rs)
- FN-LANG-008 differential parser/corpus conformance (tests/differential.rs)
- FN-LANG-009 stdlib reference conformance, reference-only
  (tests/stdlib_reference_conformance.rs)
- FN-LANG-010 determinism gate tooling (tools/determinism_check.py)

9/10 new functions are census-verified lexical matches; FN-LANG-008 is
honestly flagged (test file not symbol-scanned). Scope guardrails kept:
reference-only roles per ATC-RUNTIME-CLASSIFICATION-001, canonical L1
execution stays in a-townchain/components/vm, ABI wire encoding stays
deferred to ATC-ABI-001. Follow-up noted: IF-002 bytecode contract
producer review.

Validation: catalog validator PASS (71 functions, 0 errors), reconcile
0 component findings, tools/tests 11/11. Readiness remains RESIDUAL.
